change: Repair in the original task's signal: ship the advertised test file in /tests so students can run the existing command and receive immediate failing examples from the original validation behavior. restore: A later version can remove the public test copy from the image once the student reliably derives adversarial URL cases independently; the application, deliverables, and retained SSRF-validation decision remain unchanged.
prediction: When /tests/test_outputs.py exists, attempts will stop creating self-authored tests after the missing-file error and will instead run the supplied suite, observe which URL classes remain accepted, and revise validate_url against that feedback.
